messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Error handling in shiny
parts:
Hi,

  When a reactive errors shiny returns an error to the browser.  This is great but it means I can't get any more details, such as by using options(error=browser)

  Can you suggest how to disable or bypass the in-built trycatch so I can use standard browser or coredump error handling?

  Thanks for your recent error handling improvements; shiny no longer 'dies' when I aggressively disconnect the client.

-Alex

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Error handling in shiny
parts:
To do this, you'd need to remove all the try() and tryCatch() wrappers - otherwise, errors will still get intercepted by the most recent try/tryCatch.

I tried making some of the try() and tryCatch() statements conditional on a global option, but it looks like there many layers of them in shiny and in httpuv, and to remove them all would require some very extensive changes.

-Winston
